client_vision.what_healing_looks_like: Trauma integrated into life narrative without being defined by it. Able to rest without anxiety. Able to form and maintain secure attachments. Reconnected with authentic self. Family boundaries clear and maintained. Chosen family and support network built. Living on own terms.

Structural root named: the only anchor she has ever had is herself → dependence is foreign, not just frightening. She never has to stop being her own anchor — only allow a second point of support.

goals.rationale: Mẹ's 'never rest' programming threatens sustainability of ALL other healing. Without rest, burnout inevitable.
success_criteria: Schedules and takes rest blocks without anxiety
Recognizes mẹ's voice as internalized critic (not truth)

goals.rationale: Vương attachment = survival mechanism during divorce battle. Must honor what it gave, then release.
Internal reparenting exercise. High impact, relatively accessible. Completes childhood trauma layer.

goals.current_state: Ba=NO CONTACT, Mẹ=NO CONTACT, Quang=LOW/NO CONTACT, Hiếu=MAINTAIN CONNECTION
goals.rationale: Family map clarified. Boundaries protect healing space.
Achievement-striving (17/20) = survival strategy. Productivity anxiety = manifestation. Must build worth independent of output.
Grief for 1.5-year battle, safe rage expression, sexual rewiring needed.
Abhi arc showed intimacy triggers flooding/bite/deactivation. A 'not now' collapses into 'abandoned forever.' The brake is the skill that makes deep intimacy survivable.
success_criteria: Can tolerate a partner's temporary unavailability without preemptive abandonment
Has a container for protest urges (does not flood)
Can co-regulate rather than only self-rescue

goals.goal: Stop assigning romance the parent-sized repair job (wrong address)
goals.rationale: Romance carries a parent-repair template; friendship has none. Route the parent-wound to re-parenting + grief + safe relationships broadly, freeing romance to be 'just caring, no template.'
success_criteria: Can notice when a romantic pull is the parent-repair template firing
Enters connection from fullness, not the drowning reach

goals.rationale: Threat-mode brain cannot register small love-signals in real time (Meiji chocolate). Filter is beginning to dissolve — she now sees it.
success_criteria: Registers care/love-signals as they happen, not weeks later
Said-vs-felt gap narrows (positive data not auto-downgraded)

goals.goal: Grieve the loss of Abhi + find the 'third space'
goals.rationale: Real loss, worth mourning at true volume (guard against retroactive erasure AND self-blame). 'Third space' = heal without self-erasure or destroying the other (mother / Vuong's child / father live examples).
success_criteria: Loss mourned without erasing that it was real and good
Can name a path to her own healing that does not require self-erasure or another's destruction
